_doc: First classification of every oref0 test (M1). class: A = generalises to a universal property; B = generalises to a directional property; C = only meaningful as a concrete check; D = disabled upstream (commented out). 'general' names the property it is an instance of. M6 adds 'theorem' and 'status'.

DB-01.general: round_basal returns the nearest multiple of the pump increment (0.05 below 1 U/h without a model)

DB-02.general: round_basal: model 522 uses 0.05 increments below 1 U/h

DB-03.general: round_basal: models ending in 23/54 use 0.025 increments below 1 U/h

DB-04.general: round_basal: unknown model strings fall back to 0.05 increments

DB-05.general: round_basal is round-half-up to 0.05 (<10 U/h) or 0.1 (>=10 U/h); 6 parameterised cases

DB-06.general: eventualBG and minPredBG in range, not falling faster than expected, no SMB => neutral temp (rate = adjusted basal, 30 min)

DB-08.general: eventualBG < min_bg and falling => issued rate <= basal (here: zero temp of >= 30 min)

DB-09.general: setTempBasal keeps a running temp within +-20% of the request when its remaining duration is long enough (no new command)

DB-10.general: eventualBG < min_bg but rising faster than expected => neutral temp

DB-13.general: eventualBG < min_bg => issued rate <= basal (here: zero temp)

DB-14.general: eventualBG < min_bg => issued rate <= basal (here: zero temp)

DB-17.general: high branch with no temp running: issued rate >= basal

DB-19.general: a running temp delivering > 2x insulinReq is replaced by the required rate

DB-20.general: a running temp at or above the required rate (>5 min left) is kept

DB-21.general: concrete: a running temp below the required rate is raised

DB-22.general: IOB > max_iob => issued rate <= basal (headline H4)

DB-23.general: BG below threshold and not rising => zero temp, no microbolus (headline H3)

DB-24.general: BG below threshold and not rising => zero temp (H3); the test only checks rate < 0.8

DB-25.general: BG below threshold and not rising => zero temp (H3)

DB-29.general: concrete: barely negative delta gives a rate strictly between 0.3 and 0.8

DB-31.general: eventualBG < min_bg but rising faster than expected => neutral temp

DB-32.general: eventualBG < min_bg but rising faster than expected => neutral temp

DB-35.general: eventualBG >= max_bg, IOB < max_iob, no temp running => issued rate >= basal

DB-36.general: falling faster than expected (no SMB) => neutral temp

DB-37.general: falling faster than expected (no SMB) => neutral temp

DB-38.general: falling faster than expected (no SMB) => neutral temp

DB-39.general: eventualBG >= max_bg, IOB < max_iob, no temp running => issued rate >= basal

DB-44.general: error-coded BG (<= 10) => no rate increase; a low temp keeps running (H5)

DB-45.general: error-coded BG (<= 10) with a high temp running => replaced by basal (H5)

DB-51.general: vacuous: the profile has key "max_bg " (trailing space), so oref0 returns 'could not determine target_bg' and the assertion holds for that reason (see FINDINGS F-03)

DB-54.general: disabled upstream (block comment, old avgdelta API)

DB-63.general: disabled upstream (block comment, old avgdelta API)

DB-64.general: eventualBG < min_bg => issued rate <= basal (here: zero temp after sensitivity adjustment)

DB-68.general: rounding of maxSafeBasal for small basals (H6)

DB-69.general: in range => neutral temp, rounded at 0.025 precision for x23 pumps

DB-70.general: in range => neutral temp, rounded at 0.05 precision for x22 pumps

IOB-01.general: bilinear curve: IOB of a bolus is the full amount at t=0, in (0, amount) during DIA, 0 after DIA

IOB-02.general: concrete values for the ultra-rapid exponential curve; generalisation: 0 <= iob <= amount

IOB-06.general: concrete values for peak 44 and DIA 6

IOB-11.general: concrete temp basal history with basal profile

IOB-15.general: concrete: suspend at end of basal

IOB-16.general: concrete: suspend in middle of basal

IOB-18.general: concrete: suspend at beginning of basal

IOB-23.general: concrete: temps below base rate give negative IOB

IOB-24.general: a TempBasal with no matching duration record contributes no insulin

STB-02.general: setTempBasal(0, d) sets a zero temp of duration d

STB-03.general: setTempBasal passes through a rate within [0, maxSafeBasal] (rounded)

STB-04.general: skip_neutral_temps: a request equal to the scheduled basal cancels a running temp or does nothing

STB-11.general: concrete: 0.025 -> 0 change is issued (outside the +-20% band)

STB-12.general: no assertion (all commented out); conformance compares the output with Node

BAS-01.general: maxDailyBasal is the maximum rate of the schedule

BAS-02.general: basalLookup returns the rate of the schedule segment containing the time of day

GLG-01.general: concrete deltas from NS sgv entries
